rationale: Era's applied AI lab is deeply focused on edge intelligence and on-device AI infrastructure, while Saori brings materials science expertise from Resonac, a semiconductor and functional materials company—two complementary angles on the hardware-software stack powering next-generation AI. This is a natural conversation for exploring how advanced materials and edge AI infrastructure could intersect, especially given Era's conviction that edge inference will win over centralized cloud AI.
intro_message: Saori Miura, meet Era Qian — Era co-founded Edge (EdgeAGI) focused on edge intelligence and sovereign AI, and your materials science background at Resonac could unlock interesting hardware discussions around the infrastructure Era is building.
